chinese: 所以也许它声音没那么大，或者没有粗鲁的语言，或者没有脏话。

english: Right. That's basically what tone it down means, right? If someone says you need to tone it down, it's a little bit more direct.
chinese: 是的，你说得对。嗯，那基本的意思就是说，如果你需要降低一些，那应该用更直接的方式吧？如果有人告诉你你需要降低一点，那应该是稍微更直接点的表达方式。

english: Like you said, if your parents tell you this, it's maybe because you're being a little bit too loud or you're yelling or you're being irrespectful.
chinese: 你这么说，你的父母可能是因为你有点吵闹或者大声叫嚷，或者是不尊重他们吧。

english: Yeah.
chinese: 好的。

english: So that's why your parents would tell you, hey, you need to tone it down a bit.
chinese: 所以，这就是你的父母为什么让你稍微收敛一点的原因。

english: That's right. Or sometimes we have this in the office where someone doesn't understand how to communicate in a positive way.
chinese: 没错。有时候我们在办公室里，有人就不知道怎么用积极的方式沟通了。

english: And so they say, oh, that paper you did was really bad. It was stupid. I don't ever want to see it again.
chinese: 所以，他们说你做的那张纸真的很糟糕。那是傻瓜才会做的蠢事。我再也不想看它了。

english: Say, well, maybe you need to tone it down a little bit. Think about the words you're using and make them a little bit less harsh.
chinese: 嘿，嗯，也许你得稍微软化一下语气。想想你在用的词汇，把它们再温柔一点吧。

english: So kind of to relax, to reduce your level of being aggressive, being loud, that's to tone it down.
chinese: 所以放松一下，降低你暴躁和大声的水平，就是让你冷静下来。

english: Exactly.
chinese: 当然。

english: Okay. A lot of great phrases there. Why don't we now go back, listen to our great dialogue one last time and we'll be back to talk a little bit more.
chinese: 好的。这里有很多很棒的短语。我们接下来再回去一次，听听我们的精彩对话，然后再继续聊一些。

english: Trina, will you marry me?
chinese: Trina，你要嫁给我吗？

english: Yes, yes, yes! Dara, of course I'll marry you.
chinese: 当然，我愿意嫁给你！

english: Oh, babe, I can't wait to spend the rest of my life with you. I can't wait for all the adventures we're gonna have, for all the fights and the laughter.
chinese: 哦，宝贝儿，我迫不及待想和你共度余生了。我也急着想和你一起经历所有的冒险，参与所有的战斗与欢笑。

english: Can't wait to grow old and wrinkly with you.
chinese: 我好期待和你一起变老变丑。

english: Oh, Jared, I can't wait for our wedding. I hope you don't mind, but I've already chosen a date, six months from now in the summer.
chinese: 哎呀，杰瑞德，我真激动要结婚了。希望你不要介意，但是我已经选好了日期，六个月后夏天的那个日子。

english: Melissa saw you buying the ring last month, so I had plenty of time to start planning.
chinese: Melissa看到你上个月买戒指，所以我有足够的时间开始计划。

english: She what?
chinese: 她怎么了？

english: Oh, don't worry, sweetie. I didn't know when you were going to propose. It was still a nice surprise.
chinese: 哦，别担心，宝贝。我之前并不知道你什么时候要提的亲呢。这还是个不错的惊喜啊。

english: As I was saying, I've got it all planned out. There's almost nothing left to do. I wrote up our guest list and we will have roughly 400 guests attending.
chinese: 我正说，我已经计划好了。几乎没有什么事情需要做了。我们已经列出了嘉宾名单，大约有400位嘉宾参加。

english: 400? No need to sweat it. My parents agreed to pay for most of the wedding, which is going to be a low budget anyway.
chinese: 400？不用太紧张。我爸妈同意大部分婚礼费用，这本来就是低预算嘛。

english: So roughly 400 people, which means that the hall at Northwood Heights will be our reception venue. I thought it would be nice if we had the wedding at your parents' church, and my uncle of course would be officiating.
chinese: 所以大概有四百人，这意味着南德霍夫希尔顿酒店的会场将是我们的欢迎场地。我想如果能有婚礼在您的父母教堂举行，而且我的叔叔也会主持。

english: We'll meet with him soon for some pre-wedding counseling. The music for the wedding ceremony was a no-brainer.
chinese: 我们很快会和他见面，进行一些婚前咨询。婚礼仪式的音乐简直是手到擒来。

english: My step-sister and her string quartet will take care of that. My cousin will be the official photographer. I thought it would also be nice if his daughter could sing a solo.
chinese: 我的堂妹还有她的弦乐四重奏会搞定这件事。我侄子是专业的摄影师，我想他的女儿也来唱个独唱怎么样？

english: Did you know that she's going to be a professional opera singer?
chinese: 你知道她要成为一名专业的歌剧演员吗？

english: Oh.
chinese: 哦。

english: And then of course the ladies at the church would love to be our caterers for the banquet and we'll get the youth group to serve us.
chinese: 然后当然教堂里的女人们会想当我们的宴会上的厨师，我们还会让青年小组来为我们服务。

english: But we're thinking that your friend's band could be our entertainment for the night, though they might have to turn it down a bit. Or we could hire a DJ.
chinese: 但我觉得你朋友的乐队可能会成为今晚我们的娱乐，不过他们可能得稍微调整一下。或者我们可以请一个DJ来帮忙。

english: Your sister's husband could get us a discount with that company that does the day-court at weddings. What's her name again?
chinese: 你的姐姐夫人的公司能给我们做婚礼的当天法庭，那家公司叫什么名字？她叫什么名字呢？

english: I was thinking that we could have an island paradise theme wedding and our theme colour would be a soothing blue-like aquamarine.
chinese: 我想到我们可以举办一个海岛天堂主题婚礼，我们的主题颜色会是像海蓝宝石一样的宁静蓝色。

english: And there will be a huge seashell on the wall behind the podium where we'll make our toasts. What do you think of small packages of drink mixes for our wedding favours?
chinese: 墙后的讲台后面，会有一个巨大的海螺。你觉得我们作为婚礼邀请物的小包装饮品礼盒怎么样？

english: Who asked my missing?
chinese: 谁问起我的失踪？

english: Oh, your uncle could be our florist and his wife could make our wedding cake.
chinese: 哦，你叔叔可以是我们花店的老板，他的妻子可以为我们做婚礼蛋糕。

english: Oh wow.
chinese: 哦，哇。

english: See, it's going to be wonderful. Oh, this wedding is going to be everything like ever dreamed of.
chinese: 你看，这真是个美好的日子。哎呀，这个婚礼简直就是你梦寐以求的全部。

english: If I survived the next six months.
chinese: 如果我能在接下来的六个月里活下来。

english: Alright, so about weddings and planning out a wedding. Do you think 400 guests is a small wedding?
chinese: 好的，关于婚礼和计划婚礼的事情。你觉得四百位嘉宾的婚礼算不上是小婚礼吗？

english: No. I think this woman is out of control. In fact, in English, we have a word for a bride.
chinese: No，我觉得这个女人失控了。事实上，在英语里我们也有一个词来形容新娘子。

english: Or like a woman who's getting married that describes someone who's completely nuts about the wedding. We call her a bridezilla.
chinese: 就像一个即将结婚的女性，她形容完全疯狂于婚礼的人。我们称她为“新娘zilla”。

english: Bridezilla. That's right.
chinese: 婚礼疯魔症。没错。

english: Exactly. The movie Godzilla. He's a monster.
chinese: 没错。这部电影叫“哥斯拉”。他是个怪兽。

english: And he's out of control.
chinese: 他失控了。

english: He's out of control. And a bride who's so obsessed with her wedding that nothing else is important, she is a bridezilla.
chinese: 他失控了。一个对婚礼如此痴迷的新娘，其他事情对她来说都不重要，她就是新娘zilla。

english: Now, it's a very big thing for a woman, right? For her wedding to be nice and perfect and everything. Do you think guys are more relaxed in this sense?
chinese: 现在，对于一个女人来说，这可是一个非常重要的事情。她的婚礼要漂亮又完美，你认为男生在这方面会放松点吗？

english: I don't know. I think it depends on the guy. As always, there are some people who want to be very involved and some people who don't care.
chinese: 我不知道。我认为这取决于那个男人。总是有几个人想非常投入，有些人不想。

english: But in general, I think men are less worried about the details.
chinese: 但一般来说，我认为男性对细节的担忧较少。

english: Just as long as there's a wedding, it's fine.
chinese: 只要结婚了，就没事。

english: Exactly. Although a lot of men when the wedding actually happens start to get very nervous.
chinese: 确实。虽然婚礼当天有很多男士会开始变得非常紧张。

english: But kind of like having doubts, maybe cold feet.
chinese: 但有点像有疑虑，或许就是半途而废。

english: Yes, cold feet. Like should I get married? Should I knock it?
chinese: 是的，冷场。比如我应该结婚吗？或者我该去求婚呢？

english: Oh, I think it's very interesting because you see this in movies a lot.
chinese: 哦，我觉得挺有意思的，因为你看电影的时候经常看到。

english: And I've always wondered how often or how common is it for a guy or a girl to say no or to leave a wedding when it has already started?
chinese: 我一直很好奇，一个男生或者女生什么时候或多常见地会说不或者离开婚礼？当婚礼已经开始时。

english: Because you know, you have invited all these people, all these friends and family.
chinese: 因为你知道，你已经邀请了所有的这些朋友和家人。

english: Maybe people came from different countries and food is paid for venue.
chinese: 可能是人们来自不同的国家，食物是场地付费的。

english: You spend so much money on a wedding and for you to say no.
chinese: 你为一场婚礼花这么多钱，却连说不参加都做不到。

english: I don't know how common it is. It's very common in movies, but I don't know anyone who's experienced this.
chinese: 我不太知道怎么常见。在电影中很常见，但在我的生活中，我还没有遇到过这种情况。

english: I don't either actually now that you're bringing it up.
chinese: 我不清楚，你最近在谈论什么。

english: So maybe we could talk about this. Is this common in your country?
chinese: 所以，我们或许可以聊聊这个问题。在你们国家这种情况常见吗？

english: First of all, do people spend a lot of money on weddings?
chinese: 首先，人们在婚礼上花了很多钱吗？

english: And second of all, have you ever heard of someone actually leaving the wedding before they finished?
chinese: 而且，你有没有听说过有人在新娘子把仪式做完之前就走了？

english: Yeah, during the ceremony. Not before, during.
chinese: 是的，在仪式上。不是在仪式前，就是在仪式中。

english: During the ceremony. So our website is engluchpod.com. We hope to see you there. Until next time.
chinese: 仪式上。我们的网站是engluchpod.com。希望你能来参加。下次见。

english: Bye.
chinese: Bye. 略

english: Bye.
chinese: 再见。
